content:
Below is a namespaced composite API, `VersionedBucketDatabase`, backed by an AWS Composition using `function-patch-and-transform`.

It creates:

- A private S3 bucket with versioning and AES-256 encryption
- An RDS PostgreSQL instance with deletion protection, backups, and no public access
- An IRSA IAM role with OIDC trust and a least-privilege S3 policy
- An AWS Secrets Manager-managed RDS master password

> Assumes Upbound AWS provider APIs and `function-patch-and-transform` are installed.

```yaml
# xrd.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xversionedbucketdatabases.platform.example.io
spec:
  group: platform.example.io
  names:
    kind: XVersionedBucketDatabase
    plural: xversionedbucketdatabases
  claimNames:
    kind: VersionedBucketDatabase
    plural: versionedbucketdatabases
  defaultCompositionRef:
    name: versioned-bucket-database-aws
  connectionSecretKeys:
    - endpoint
    - port
    - database
    - username
    - masterSecretARN
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          required:
            - spec
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              required:
                - parameters
              properties:
                parameters:
                  type: object
                  required:
                    - environment
                    - region
                    - providerConfigName
                    - bucketName
                    - dbSubnetGroupName
                    - dbSecurityGroupIds
                    - oidcProviderArn
                    - oidcProviderHostPath
                    - serviceAccountNamespace
                    - serviceAccountName
                  properties:
                    environment:
                      type: string
                      enum:
                        - dev
                        - prod

                    region:
                      type: string
                      description: AWS region for this environment.

                    providerConfigName:
                      type: string
                      description: >
                        ProviderConfig dedicated to the target environment/account.

                    bucketName:
                      type: string
                      description: Globally unique S3 bucket name.
                      minLength: 3
                      maxLength: 63

                    databaseName:
                      type: string
                      default: app

                    databaseUsername:
                      type: string
                      default: appadmin

                    dbInstanceClass:
                      type: string
                      default: db.t3.micro

                    dbAllocatedStorageGiB:
                      type: integer
                      minimum: 20
                      default: 20

                    dbSubnetGroupName:
                      type: string
                      description: Existing RDS DB subnet group.

                    dbSecurityGroupIds:
                      type: array
                      minItems: 1
                      items:
                        type: string

                    multiAZ:
                      type: boolean
                      default: false

                    storageEncrypted:
                      type: boolean
                      default: true

                    kmsKeyId:
                      type: string
                      description: >
                        Optional KMS key ARN for RDS encryption. When omitted,
                        the AWS-managed RDS key is used.

                    oidcProviderArn:
                      type: string
                      description: >
                        ARN of the EKS cluster IAM OIDC provider.

                    oidcProviderHostPath:
                      type: string
                      description: >
                        OIDC issuer host and path without https://, for example
                        oidc.eks.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLE.

                    serviceAccountNamespace:
                      type: string

                    serviceAccountName:
                      type: string

                writeConnectionSecretToRef:
                  type: object
                  required:
                    - name
                  properties:
                    name:
                      type: string
                    namespace:
                      type: string

            status:
              type: object
              properties:
                bucketArn:
                  type: string
                bucketName:
                  type: string
                databaseEndpoint:
                  type: string
                databasePort:
                  type: integer
                masterSecretARN:
                  type: string
                roleArn:
                  type: string
```

```yaml
# composition.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: versioned-bucket-database-aws
  labels:
    provider: aws
    platform.example.io/service: versioned-bucket-database
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: platform.example.io/v1alpha1
    kind: XVersionedBucketDatabase

  mode: Pipeline

  pipeline:
    - step: patch-and-transform
      functionRef:
        name: function-patch-and-transform
      input:
        apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources
        resources:
          # The bucket itself. Versioning, encryption, and public-access
          # controls are separate AWS resources below.
          - name: bucket
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Bucket
              metadata:
                labels:
                  platform.example.io/resource: assets
              spec:
                deletionPolicy: Orphan
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  forceDestroy: false
                  tags:
                    ManagedBy: crossplane
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
                toFieldPath: metadata.labels[platform.example.io/bucket-name]

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Environment

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.bucketArn

              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.id
                toFieldPath: status.bucketName

          - name: bucket-versioning
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketVersioning
              spec:
                deletionPolicy: Delete
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  versioningConfiguration:
                    - status: Enabled
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

          - name: bucket-encryption
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
              spec:
                deletionPolicy: Delete
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  rule:
                    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                        - sseAlgorithm: AES256
                      bucketKeyEnabled: true
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

          - name: bucket-public-access-block
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
              spec:
                deletionPolicy: Delete
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  blockPublicAcls: true
                  blockPublicPolicy: true
                  ignorePublicAcls: true
                  restrictPublicBuckets: true
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

          # PostgreSQL database. AWS creates and stores the master password in
          # Secrets Manager because manageMasterUserPassword is enabled.
          - name: database
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
              kind: Instance
              metadata:
                labels:
                  platform.example.io/resource: database
              spec:
                deletionPolicy: Orphan
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  engine: postgres
                  engineVersion: "16"
                  instanceClass: db.t3.micro
                  allocatedStorage: 20
                  maxAllocatedStorage: 100
                  storageType: gp3
                  storageEncrypted: true
                  multiAZ: false

                  dbName: app
                  username: appadmin
                  manageMasterUserPassword: true

                  deletionProtection: true
                  backupRetentionPeriod: 7
                  backupWindow: "03:00-04:00"
                  maintenanceWindow: "sun:04:00-sun:05:00"
                  copyTagsToSnapshot: true
                  skipFinalSnapshot: false
                  finalSnapshotIdentifierPrefix: crossplane-final

                  publiclyAccessible: false
                  autoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
                  applyImmediately: false

                  dbSubnetGroupName: replace-me
                  vpcSecurityGroupIds:
                    - sg-replace-me

                  tags:
                    ManagedBy: crossplane
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Environment

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.databaseName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbName

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.databaseUsername
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.username

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbInstanceClass
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbAllocatedStorageGiB
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.allocatedStorage

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbSubnetGroupName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbSubnetGroupName

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbSecurityGroupIds
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.vpcSecurityGroupIds

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.multiAZ
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAZ

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.storageEncrypted
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.storageEncrypted

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.kmsKeyId
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.kmsKeyId
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.address
                toFieldPath: status.databaseEndpoint

              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.port
                toFieldPath: status.databasePort

              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.masterUserSecret[0].secretArn
                toFieldPath: status.masterSecretARN
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

              - type: ToConnectionSecretKey
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.address
                toConnectionSecretKey: endpoint

              - type: ToConnectionSecretKey
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.port
                toConnectionSecretKey: port

              - type: ToConnectionSecretKey
                fromFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbName
                toConnectionSecretKey: database

              - type: ToConnectionSecretKey
                fromFieldPath: spec.forProvider.username
                toConnectionSecretKey: username

              - type: ToConnectionSecretKey
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.masterUserSecret[0].secretArn
                toConnectionSecretKey: masterSecretARN
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

          # IAM role trusted only by the selected EKS OIDC provider and exact
          # Kubernetes service account.
          - name: service-account-role
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Role
              metadata:
                labels:
                  platform.example.io/resource: service-account-role
              spec:
                deletionPolicy: Delete
                forProvider:
                  assumeRolePolicy: "{}"
                  description: IRSA role managed by Crossplane
                  maxSessionDuration: 3600
                  tags:
                    ManagedBy: crossplane
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Environment

              - type: CombineFromComposite
                combine:
                  strategy: string
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.oidcProviderArn
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.oidcProviderHostPath
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.oidcProviderHostPath
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.serviceAccountNamespace
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.serviceAccountName
                  string:
                    fmt: >-
                      {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Federated":"%s"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"%s:aud":"sts.amazonaws.com","%s:sub":"system:serviceaccount:%s:%s"}}}]}
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy

              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.roleArn

          # Exact S3 actions only. No wildcard IAM actions are granted.
          - name: service-account-policy
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: RolePolicy
              spec:
                deletionPolicy: Delete
                forProvider:
                  roleSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  policy: "{}"
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

              - type: CombineFromComposite
                combine:
                  strategy: string
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
                  string:
                    fmt: >-
                      {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"ListAssetsBucket","Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:ListBucket","s3:GetBucketLocation"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::%s"},{"Sid":"ReadWriteAssets","Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:GetObjectVersion","s3:PutObject","s3:DeleteObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::%s/*"}]}
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy

    - step: automatically-detect-ready-composed-resources
      functionRef:
        name: function-auto-ready
```

Install the functions:

```yaml
# functions.yaml
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Function
metadata:
  name: function-patch-and-transform
spec:
  package: xpkg.crossplane.io/crossplane-contrib/function-patch-and-transform:v0.8.2
---
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Function
metadata:
  name: function-auto-ready
spec:
  package: xpkg.crossplane.io/crossplane-contrib/function-auto-ready:v0.5.0
```

Example independently deployable claims:

```yaml
# dev.yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.io/v1alpha1
kind: VersionedBucketDatabase
metadata:
  name: webapp-dev
  namespace: webapp-dev
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: dev
    region: us-east-1
    providerConfigName: aws-dev

    bucketName: example-webapp-assets-dev

    databaseName: webapp
    databaseUsername: webappadmin
    dbInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
    dbAllocatedStorageGiB: 20
    dbSubnetGroupName: webapp-dev
    dbSecurityGroupIds:
      - sg-0123456789abcdef0
    multiAZ: false
    storageEncrypted: true

    oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::111111111111:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVEXAMPLE
    oidcProviderHostPath: oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVEXAMPLE
    serviceAccountNamespace: webapp
    serviceAccountName: webapp

  writeConnectionSecretToRef:
    name: webapp-dev-database
```

```yaml
# prod.yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.io/v1alpha1
kind: VersionedBucketDatabase
metadata:
  name: webapp-prod
  namespace: webapp-prod
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: prod
    region: eu-west-1
    providerConfigName: aws-prod

    bucketName: example-webapp-assets-prod

    databaseName: webapp
    databaseUsername: webappadmin
    dbInstanceClass: db.t3.medium
    dbAllocatedStorageGiB: 100
    dbSubnetGroupName: webapp-prod
    dbSecurityGroupIds:
      - sg-0fedcba9876543210
    multiAZ: true
    storageEncrypted: true
    kmsKeyId: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:222222222222:key/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000

    oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::222222222222:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/id/PRODEXAMPLE
    oidcProviderHostPath: oidc.eks.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/id/PRODEXAMPLE
    serviceAccountNamespace: webapp
    serviceAccountName: webapp

  writeConnectionSecretToRef:
    name: webapp-prod-database
```

Operational notes:

- Use separate `aws-dev` and `aws-prod` `ProviderConfig` objects, ideally targeting separate AWS accounts.
- The Kubernetes connection Secret contains the endpoint and Secrets Manager ARN, not the database password. The password remains encrypted in AWS Secrets Manager.
- Configure Kubernetes encryption at rest or a Crossplane external Secret Store for the connection metadata.
- `deletionPolicy: Orphan` is used for the bucket and database to complement S3 versioning and RDS deletion protection.
- The requested three-resource scope does not provision EKS, HTTPS/CloudFront/ACM, or production cross-region S3 replication from the broader canonical scenario.
